model.name: BUG12: Bug-type chain node shows NO children in /trace — forward-key resolver lacks Bug entry.
model.description: BUG: in /trace, expanding a Bug-type chain node shows NO children. The chain (req→uc→class→method→impl→test) exists but doesn't render because the FORWARD_KEYS resolver has no entry for ior:class:Bug. It resolves Requirement→useCases but not Bug→useCases (Bug extends Requirement per R20.4 but the resolver doesn't inherit). FIX: add Bug (and ChangeRequest) to the FORWARD_KEYS map with the same forward keys as Requirement (useCases[], tasks[]). Tron evidence: IMG_4038.
model.crossRefNote: R20.4 (Bug+ChangeRequest extend Requirement) defined the OOP subtype. BUG12 = the FORWARD_KEYS resolver doesn't recognize the subtype — needs Bug/ChangeRequest entries with same keys as Requirement.

intendedChain.useCase: traceChildren.resolveBugType — Bug/ChangeRequest nodes resolve children via same forward keys as Requirement
intendedChain.test: RED: tap a Bug node (e.g. BUG8 12cf7bb5) in /trace → assert its UC child (38204812) renders → chain expands fully. Currently FAILS (no children).
